children: President Donald Trump said the United States secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves and called it the biggest oil deal in history. According to BeInCrypto, Brent crude still rose from about $88 to $90.48 by Monday, as traders focused on Middle East supply risks rather than the Venezuela deal. The agreement gives a private venture a 100-year lease on 17 oil fields, with the U.S. holding a 55% stake, while Delcy Rodriguez said the venture could draw more than $100 billion in investment.

title: Trump Says U.S. Secured Majority Control Of 65 Billion Venezuelan Oil Barrels
